title: Bulcheonggaekgwa Chumeul
titleNative: 불청객과 춤을
synopsis: At the start of her second year of middle school, Ji Hae-Ro ends up in the same class as her ex-boyfriend, whom she’d been secretly dating before he dumped her. But wait a minute! It’s bad enough that I’m in the same class as the guy who dumped me, but now he’s telling me he has a crush on someone in our class? And of all people, that person happens to be… Choi Jin-Young?! There’s one secret between Ji Hae-Ro and Choi Jin-young that no one else is supposed to know… Surrounded by nothing but unwelcome guests, will Hae-Ro be able to make it through puberty unscathed? (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

It’s become too much of a despairing environment that he’s come to hate it. And so, he finally decided to part ways with her. However, unbeknownst to everyone was that the materials Lloyd gathered were all high-grade materials no one else could gather. The mage, who was treated as “incompetent” and saw himself as such, now aims for an ideal easy going life!

title: They Were 11!
titleNative: 11人いる!
synopsis: They Were 11 is about ten Galactic University recruits who have passed many levels only to be given one final test. They are told to travel to an ancient spaceship and live there, together, for fifty-three days. This is not a problem until the ten recruits, hailing from diverse backgrounds and planets, discover that there are actually eleven of them on the ship. In fact, this problem turns out to be the test, as they have to trust each other in order to survive, even though one of them is an impostor. (Source: VIZ Media) Note: Won the 21st Shogakukan Manga Award for Shoujo in 1975.

title: Taika's Reason
titleNative: タイカの理性
synopsis: Due to a declining birth rate, pets are being transformed into humanoid members of society. But are they truly human? Or are humans truly animals? When misanthrope Ao discovers her family dog, pit bull Taika, standing over the mauled body of her father, she must decide whether to forgive or forget. Ao isn't ready to lose both her beloved father and her devoted pet, so when her mother has Taika humanized, Ao embraces the new dogman and even brings him to school with her. There, Taika meets a German shepherd, an elite police dogman, and begins to unlearn canine behaviors and replace them with human customs. Now, the two dogmen compete to see who will be the first to track down the source of the mysterious traces of blood in Ao's locker… (Source: VIZ Media)

Asuka declares, "I will defeat all the Utsuro in this world with my own hands," and tells Natsumi that they will live together until she turns 19, when the nectar disappears from her body. Asuka shows overwhelming strength in her battle with Utsuro, but she has a secret... (Source: Natalie, translated)

synopsis: When her mother marries into high society, Lilisa Suzunomiya is forced to leave her commoner ways behind. Now enrolled at an elite all-girls academy, she’s expected to smile politely, sip tea, and hang up her beloved guitar for (ugh…) a violin. But when she hears drums echoing from the old school building, Lilisa is dragged into a jam session with the secretly rebellious young lady Otoha Kurogane, and her passion for music is reignited! High society better watch out—the academy’s most demure maidens are teaming up to form an elegant rock band the likes of which the world has never seen! (Source: Yen Press)
